_comment: Curated non-CVE release-note bugs for pgFirstAid.
Source of truth: this JSON file. Regenerate the inline VALUES rows in
`python tools/generate_cve_sql.py`. The on-disk inline VALUES rows are
regenerated on every commit; edit only this file.
These are hand-picked from the PostgreSQL release notes — ponytail ceiling:
this is curated, not exhaustive. Add a row when an operator-reported bug
proves it deserves a permanent seat.

bugs.summary: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT can fail to enforce unique-constraint visibility checks in some MVCC edge cases
B-tree page deletion can leak pages on workloads with heavy concurrent UPDATEs
Logical replication subscriber can crash mid-transaction on large in-progress changes
B-tree index page splits could corrupt the tree on high-concurrency inserts
Logical decoding can miss subtransaction changes for aborted DDL
Vacuum memory accounting leaks over many iterations of aggressive autovacuum
COPY FROM routing into partitioned tables can drop rows under concurrent partition attach
pg_createsubscriber can leave slots uninitialized, breaking logical failover on first switchover
MERGE ... WHEN NOT MATCHED against an inheritance child can produce duplicate rows under concurrent INSERT
